title: Simultaneous bilateral stress fractures in a homemaker: a case report and literature review.
journal: Journal of the American Podiatric Medical Association

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: Stress fractures commonly occur in athletes and military cadets due to repetitive stress on the bony cortex. Stress fractures of the tibia are commonly localized proximally and occur during aerobic weightbearing exercises. This is an unusual case of bilateral simultaneous distal tibial stress fracture in a young homemaker.
